name: datepicker
title: Datepicker
description: A calendar datepicker component with single date, range, and popover modes. Uses namespace exports: Datepicker.Calendar.

migration.guide: API changed: removed lucide-react dependency, now uses @remixicon/react. Removed datepicker.css file. Removed CalendarDayButton export. Simplified to single Calendar export with react-day-picker v9 classNames API.

docs.lead: A calendar datepicker component with single date, range, and popover modes.
docs.usage:
import * as Datepicker from "@/components/ui/datepicker"

<Datepicker.Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Inline calendar for single date selection.

examples.title: Popover
examples.description: Date picker inside a popover triggered by a button.
examples.code:
<Popover.Root>
  <Popover.Trigger asChild>
    <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
      {date ? format(date, 'LLL dd, y') : 'Select a date'}
    </Button.Root>
  </Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content className="p-0" showArrow={false}>
    <Datepicker.Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover.Root>

examples.title: With Approval
examples.code:
Select a date
Cancel Apply

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Date range selection in a popover.

examples.title: With Form Field
examples.description: Datepicker composed with FormField for consistent label and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Date of Birth"
  required
  hint="Select your date of birth."
>
  <Datepicker.Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
</FormField.Root>

api.name: Datepicker.Calendar
api.description: The calendar component. Extends react-day-picker DayPicker props.
